plugin.name: sonata-corners
plugin._long: Rounds all four corners of windows Wayfire decorates (pixdecor), like Sonata's own windows.

option.name: outline
option._long: Hairline along the rounded frame (Sonata sets it per appearance).

option.name: debug_input
option._long: Every pointer button in the session log: the device, the window under the pointer and what Wayfire did with it.

option.name: own_frame_apps
option._short: Apps with their own square frame
option._long: Exact app_ids of undecorated apps rounded too (Steam draws its own title bar).

option.name: capture_hidden
option._long: App ids of surfaces shown on screen but never in a recording or a screen share (ext-image-copy-capture).

option.name: capture_clients
option._long: Programs (process names) that capture the displays without the surfaces above: recorders and screen sharing. Others, screenshots included, use the compositor's own capture.
